rationale.edition: All changed paths are OSS-owned locations (web/src/components/settings/*, web/src/layouts/MainLayout.vue, web/src/locales/*, src/api/common/src/auth/jwt.rs, src/api/management/src/request/organization/settings.rs, src/common/src/meta/organization.rs, src/config/src/meta/user.rs, scripts/translations/*). None live under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/. The backend feature is gated with #[cfg(feature = "cloud")] (cloud, not enterprise), and no enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/sensitive-data/logo-management) appear in the paths, so edition is oss.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change is a genuine user-facing feature: a new Domain -> Organization mapping CRUD section in Organization Settings (add/edit/delete via dialogs with domain, org, role, and group inputs plus validation). No skip markers present (feature_hint.txt and trigger_comment.txt are both empty, no tests-added label passed).
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. A meta-org admin can add, edit, and delete domain-to-org mappings in the Organization Settings UI, with required-field validation, duplicate-domain blocking, a role selector, and an optional user group. This is a new, user-exercisable UI flow (web/src/components/settings/DomainOrgMappings.vue + DomainOrgMappingDialog.vue wired into OrganizationSettings.vue) that should be verified in the browser.
rationale.area: The change is a general org/settings/admin feature with no single product-area home (Logs/Metrics/Traces/etc.). It lives under web/src/components/settings/ and the closest existing sibling specs are in tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/GeneralTests/ (serviceAccount, theme-management, logoManagement, ingestion-config), so area = GeneralTests.
rationale.group: playwright_group = GeneralTests because the ci-matrix shard named GeneralTests (actual_folder GeneralTests) already carries cross-cutting settings/admin specs (serviceAccount.spec.js, theme-management.spec.js, ingestion-config.spec.js, logoManagement.spec.js) and is the natural shard for an organization-settings feature.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The only test file changed is web/src/components/settings/OrganizationSettings.spec.ts, which is a Vitest unit test, not an E2E spec under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so existing_tests_in_diff is false and there is no existing E2E coverage to extend.
